sentences.text:
This Civil Miscellaneous Appeal has been filed Challenging the award passed by the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, III Additional District Judge, Coimbatore, made in M.C.O.P.No.753 of 2019 dated 08.06.2023.
2.

entities.text: Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, III Additional District Judge, Coimbatore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the appellant/Transport Corporation submitted that the deceased was running an electrical workshop under the name and style of M/s.B.A.Systems.
He further submitted that the Tribunal has fixed a monthly income of Rs.15,000/- as such is erroneous one and there is no document produced by the claimants with regard to income of the deceased.
He further submitted that the accident was happened only rash and negligent driving of the deceased.

Hence,
he prayed to set aside the findings of the Tribunal.
3. The learned counsel for the respondents 1 to 4 submitted that the deceased was running an electrical workshop and he was earning https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

( Uploaded on:
29/07/2025 07:43:07 pm ) Rs.1,00,000/- per month, but the Tribunal has fixed a notional income of Rs.15,000/- but they claimed a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-.
He further submitted that at the time of the accident, the deceased was about 37 years old and he was hale and healthy and after the said accident of the family of the deceased suffered.
Therefore, the Tribunal has rightly appreciated the facts and circumstances and awarded the compensation, which needs no interference.

4. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, as well as the fact that at the time of the accident, the deceased was approximately 37 years old and earning a monthly income of Rs.
1,00,000.
Further, there is no proof produced on the side of the respondents/claimants with regard to monthly income.
Therefore, the Tribunal has fixed a notional monthly income of Rs.15,000/- and the same can be considered by this Court.
Therefore, the Tribunal has rightly appreciated the facts and circumstances and awarded the compensation, which needs no interference.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

5. In the result, this Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is dismissed and the Judgment and decree dated 08.06.2023 made in M.C.O.P.No.753 of 2019 on the file of the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/ III Additional District Judge, Coimbatore is confirmed.
